title: Guildborne free production tools and motion research
scope: User exact8 motion repositories plus named-tool identity review and official native tools; no downloaded packs.

exactUserRepositories.title: hyperframes
exactUserRepositories.proposedUse: First-choice local HTML/CSS composition for titles, captions and overlays on truthful Studio footage.
exactUserRepositories.freeRoute: Local engine has no per-render commercial threshold; agent inference, optional cloud/AWS/media APIs are separate.
exactUserRepositories.limits: Node 22+, Chromium/Puppeteer and FFmpeg dependencies; skills can install other workflows and reach media/cloud providers. Pin and review before executing; do not call publish/cloud commands.

exactUserRepositories.title: remotion
exactUserRepositories.proposedUse: React video composition if existing project uses React and free eligibility is established.
exactUserRepositories.freeRoute: Free for individuals, for-profit organisations with up to 3 employees, non-profits and noncommercial evaluation; other organisations require Company License.
exactUserRepositories.limits: Not MIT. Licence mentions upcoming 5.0 change; check pinned version. Local compute separate from paid cloud rendering and agent fees; no Roblox rig/KeyframeSequence export proven.

exactUserRepositories.title: gsap-skills
exactUserRepositories.proposedUse: Official web timeline/easing/stagger/cleanup guidance; transfer design principles to native TweenService with original Luau.
exactUserRepositories.freeRoute: Skills MIT; GSAP runtime/plugins currently free including commercial use under separate GSAP Standard License.
exactUserRepositories.limits: JS/DOM/React/web runtime cannot be inserted as Guildborne gameplay UI. Runtime licence is not MIT; preserve separate licence. Skills recommend dependencies; no execution audited.

exactUserRepositories.title: animate
exactUserRepositories.proposedUse: Canvas motion, storyboard/contact-sheet checks and procedural score references for lore/title sequences.
exactUserRepositories.freeRoute: Local canvas/render/synth route can avoid external generator APIs; coding-agent access remains separate.
exactUserRepositories.limits: Node 18+, Playwright/Chromium, FFmpeg; optional ElevenLabs voice and faster-whisper need separate dependency/model/right review. Built-in style/font references do not clear all media rights.

exactUserRepositories.title: claude-motion
exactUserRepositories.proposedUse: Study contact sheets, timeline/cue-sheet synchronization and Python synth for original UI/spell cues.
exactUserRepositories.freeRoute: Repo MIT; procedural synth source uses local Python; Remotion eligibility, agent and optional ElevenLabs costs separate.
exactUserRepositories.limits: Node 20+, Python 3, FFmpeg and browser; local synth/package source seen, not run. Claimed LUFS/mastering results are upstream claims; outputs still need ear/peak/loop tests.

exactUserRepositories.title: product-launch-motion
exactUserRepositories.proposedUse: Closed-form spring/timing/render-review patterns for an original Guildborne feature reel.
exactUserRepositories.freeRoute: Local HTML/Playwright/FFmpeg workflow; agent and music rights separate; advertised$10 hosted film service excluded.
exactUserRepositories.limits: Source now v2 plain HTML/springs, not legacy GSAP/HyperFrames; marketing model recommendations are not verified host capabilities. Website capture/media and shell rendering need review.

exactUserRepositories.title: claude-remotion-skill
exactUserRepositories.proposedUse: Read theme/timing/caption and render-inspect-fix rules without importing competing project instructions.
exactUserRepositories.freeRoute: MIT skill; Remotion free only when eligible; Claude subscription/API explicitly needed by README automation.
exactUserRepositories.limits: README calls Remotion free/open-source too broadly; preserve Remotion own licence. Example audio synthesis exists but not executed; dependency/asset/telemetry review pending.

exactUserRepositories.title: motion-graphics-skills
exactUserRepositories.proposedUse: Brief/storyboard/brand/motion review references and social-reel export for footage actually captured from Guildborne.
exactUserRepositories.freeRoute: Skills MIT; local HyperFrames or Chrome/FFmpeg renderer route; agent/model accounts not free merely because noAPIkey is required.
exactUserRepositories.limits: README counts13/14/15 disagree; no fixed count asserted. brand-intake writes brand.md/MOTION.md/CLAUDE.md; do not let copied rules replace Guildborne contract. No native Roblox output verified.

namedToolExtensions.title: Trail-Code
namedToolExtensions.proposedUse: Candidate structural code graph for source navigation; existing rg/Luau tooling remains baseline.
namedToolExtensions.freeRoute: Structural tree-sitter graph is local/no model; deep summaries use provider key or local model.
namedToolExtensions.limits: Requested trailhq/Graft redirects to Trail-Code. Lua broad support advertised, Luau fidelity unverified. init writes hooks/config/AGENTS.md; default usage/version network checks and opt-out telemetry require review.

namedToolExtensions.title: codebase-memory-mcp
namedToolExtensions.proposedUse: Prefer isolated evaluation of local Luau index/query when rg needs supplementation.
namedToolExtensions.freeRoute: Upstream claims local static binary with no self-initiated network or API requirement.
namedToolExtensions.limits: Luau listed supported but unbenchmarked; token/performance claims not Guildborne measurements. Index/database/filesystem access, tools, build/release integrity and actual .luau parse need review.

namedToolExtensions.title: OpenMontage
namedToolExtensions.proposedUse: Local FFmpeg trimming, mixing, subtitles and scene-review concepts only; avoid broad pipeline install.
namedToolExtensions.freeRoute: Local post-production offered free; cloud video/music/TTS/image APIs and agent inference separate.
namedToolExtensions.limits: Large dependency/provider surface; model weights/media licences distinct. AGPL source/network redistribution obligations require precise review if modifying/serving; no licence assigned to Guildborne game.

namedToolExtensions.title: agency-agents
namedToolExtensions.proposedUse: Compare review/production role prompts with existing Studio-v3 specialists.
namedToolExtensions.freeRoute: Prompt files free; model calls/tools/services separate.
namedToolExtensions.limits: Does not create agents/tool capabilities by itself. Avoid replacing canonical roles/ledger/scopes or bulk importing commercial/social workflows.

namedToolExtensions.title: diagram-design
namedToolExtensions.proposedUse: Architecture/quest/state diagrams in HTML/SVG/PNG for planning/review.
namedToolExtensions.freeRoute: Skill/reference files local; host inference and browser/export tools separate.
namedToolExtensions.limits: Source parses diagram files and can write project profiles; no gameplay UI. Count/version drift; use selected type only.

namedToolExtensions.title: scientific-agent-skills
namedToolExtensions.proposedUse: Potential statistical study-design/time-series/visualization reference for measured playtest/performance data.
namedToolExtensions.freeRoute: Skill files free; BYOK services/cloud databases/compute have distinct terms and possible cost.
namedToolExtensions.limits: Most biomedical/chemistry tasks outside Guildborne scope; no blanket install. Scientific rigour claims do not replace physical-device evidence.

namedToolExtensions.title: skills
namedToolExtensions.proposedUse: Use focused ambiguity/decision review only for unresolved design branches.
namedToolExtensions.freeRoute: Markdown skill free; host-model cost separate.
namedToolExtensions.limits: User-invoked interview primitive; does not authorize endless interviews or supersede already approved implementation.

namedToolExtensions.title: skills
namedToolExtensions.proposedUse: Nearest verified upstream is grill-with-docs: shared terminology, GLOSSARY and ADR decisions.
namedToolExtensions.limits: Exact requested name grill-doc not verified. Keep alias unresolved rather than claiming installed skill. Can mutate project docs; root contract still owns scope.

namedToolExtensions.title: OpenDesign identity unresolved

candidates.fit: Portable design intake/context skills; host-model access separate.
Local-first design app/BYOK CLI integrations, HTML/slide/video preview; API generation costs and provider/credential flows separate.
Open CoDesign BYOK prototype/slide/PDF app; automatic credential-import feature unsuitable without explicit destination review.

namedToolExtensions.limits: Three live roots refer to different products. None established as exact user intended upstream; all offline design references, not native Roblox runtime. The vustudio README also points to nexu-io/open-design; that claimed upstream route has not been independently resolved here.

nativeTools.supportedFact: Built-in stdio bridge; latest Studio, trusted client and explicit studio_id required. Documented generation/edit/play tools do not prove the current connection exposes them.
Native planning, script/object and mesh workflows. Procedural generation: 50 per rolling 24 hours; default mesh limit: 10,000 triangles. Current mesh request quota unspecified.
Prompt-based tiling MaterialVariant creation; base material physical properties matter; current request quota unspecified.
Beta mesh-context textures and art-style references. Transparent VFX atlas generation not verified; old 2024 quotas are not asserted current.
Particle/beam/trail/light authoring. Custom flipbook grids; engine maxima of 400/sec desktop and 100/sec mobile are not effect budgets. Low-memory clients may disable flipbooks.
AudioPlayer/Emitter/Listener/Wire and effects play/process audio, rather than arbitrary SFX/music generation. Preserve source rights and experience permissions.
Free Store audio. Audio guide: 2,000 verified /100 unverified uploads per 30 days. Open Cloud guide: 100/10 monthly API uploads. Keep route-specific quotas distinct.
Free open-source local recording, editing and tone/noise/chirp/pluck synthesis; optional plugin/cloud costs are separate.
Free open-source painting and frame-animation PNG sequences for later atlas packing. Video transparency unsupported; this is local authoring, not AI generation.
TTS: 300 characters/request; default allowance 1 + CCU x6 requests/minute. Paid extension $5/1M requests excluded. Thai TTS unverified; Thai STT is separate.

decision: Keep Roblox Animator/Animation Editor/TweenService/nativeVFX runtime for gameplay.
HyperFrames local rendering preferred offline trailer reference; Remotion conditional on eligibility.
Use original media and truthful Studio footage; web-rendered demo is not gameplay evidence.
No bulk skill imports/global hooks/credential harvesting/paidAPI calls.
Pin commit and inspect selected commands/dependencies/media licences before later scoped adoption.

acceptance.webReviewScope: Exact eight README and licence routes reviewed; named extensions have mixed verified and unresolved identities, explicitly marked per record. Full code/dependency/telemetry audit not performed.
